strategies.idea: Go long when short-term average trend turns up relative to long-term average, exit when it reverses.
strategies.name: SMA Crossover

strategies.idea: Stay long only while price is above a slow EMA, indicating an established uptrend.
strategies.name: EMA Trend Filter

strategies.idea: Buy after oversold conditions and exit once momentum recovers to neutral/overbought territory.
strategies.name: RSI Mean Reversion

strategies.idea: Enter on a new 55-day high breakout and exit on a new 20-day low breakdown, a classic trend-following channel.
strategies.name: Rolling Breakout

strategies.idea: Hold when positive 60-day momentum confirms an uptrend, exit when momentum turns negative.
strategies.name: ROC Momentum

strategies.idea: Combine a price-above-SMA uptrend with a calm volatility regime, exiting on trend break or volatility spike.
strategies.name: Low Volatility Trend
